correctness.rationale: PASS. For tau^3=tau^2+tau+1 and xi=tau^{-1}=tau^2-tau-1, parity-selected signed coordinate permutations generate exactly 24 snub-cube vertices. Multiaffinity of the oriented determinant reduces the extremal absolute volume on P^4 to finite vertex quadruples. The source exact certificate enumerates all C(24,4)=10626 quadruples as elements of Z[tau], reduces via the irreducible cubic and certifies every inequality using a rational isolating interval. It gets max determinant 8+4tau+4tau^2, 24 maximizing vertex tetrahedra, and the incidence profile 72 triples with one maximizing apex and eight bases with three maximizers, exactly one such base per maximal vertex tetrahedron; supporting-plane sign checks prove their movable apex triples are actual facets. The one-special-base incidence blocks two independently variable vertices, so separate affinity classifies all continuous equality points as eight 2D families. Direct independent floating-point enumeration reconstructed 24 vertices and all 10626 determinants, reproduced 24 maxima, 8 base triples and volume 4.81484168208; the rigorous sign certificate remains source exact arithmetic. Edge-length conversion and reflection preserve volume. Limits: fixed snub geometry only, finite exact enumeration is exhaustive here but not a synthetic all-solids theorem.
